description:
Search properties across Spur's data providers in one search. Set listing_status to search current listings (ZHomes); leave it out to search off-market and owner records, routed automatically to the best source (county records, distress data) or to the provider the user named.

Each value is labeled with the provider that supplied it. Filters return three states: matched, unknown (could not be checked, shown separately), or excluded. Costs 1 search credit plus data credits per record returned; an empty page is free. Requires confirm=true after the user approved running the search. Follow with spur_save_data_results to keep results as properties.

confirm.description: Set to true ONLY after the user explicitly approved running this search. Never assume approval.

cursor.description: Next-page cursor returned by the preceding search; keep the same filters

filters.description: Data Search filters, e.g. from spur_parse_data_search: minPrice, maxPrice, minBeds, minYearsOwned, minEquityPercent, offMarketOnly, transferredWithinDays, preForeclosureWithinDays, conditions[]

keep_table.description: Keep the search as a table and record returned signed rows

listing_status.description: Only for listing searches; omit for off-market and owner records

provider.description: Provider key from spur_list_data_providers, only when the user asked for one

table_id.description: Append this page to an existing search table

name: spur_data_search
title: Data Search
